scheme_name: Sweekruti: Assistance to Parents of Transgender Children
other_conditions: Applicant must be the parent or legal guardian of the transgender child
The transgender child must be under 18 years of age
The child must exhibit gender non‑conforming behavior
Assistance terminates when the child reaches 18 years of age
In case of death of the parent, assistance may be provided to the guardian upon production of a Certificate of Guardianship issued by the Competent Authority
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,500 per transgender child per month until the child turns 18 years old.
